allowed_evidence: bounded offline native discovery output with hash and concrete target
parser-led structured configuration evidence with file and line or document locator
author_decision: Human validation is not part of this protocol; independence refers to implementation and evidence-path independence.

decision_rules.generic_defect: Only a generic mechanism supported by independent evidence may trigger global U correction and a complete 400-observation rerun; package-specific overrides are forbidden.

execution_constraints.failure_mapping: timeout, missing tool, unsafe resolution, or native failure becomes indeterminate, never negative
execution_constraints.limits: bounded CPU, wall time, address space, process count, and output
execution_constraints.source: read-only mount where native sandboxing is available

forbidden_inputs: production U rule trigger, rule identifier, regex, or evidence snippet

selection.counterexample_target: All 301 remaining observations, searched only for clear supported-domain missed entrypoints

stop_rules: stop after exhaustive certification of 99 positives and search of all 301 remaining observations
correct and rerun only demonstrated generic U defects
retain machine-indeterminate cases as a disclosed limitation; do not add human validation

supported_families.autotools_make: explicit supported check/test target or Automake test declaration
supported_families.cmake_ctest: CTest/native discovered test or structured CMake test command
supported_families.go: Go native or declaration-level test target semantics
supported_families.gradle: Gradle test task or Java plugin with standard test source set
supported_families.maven: Maven standard lifecycle with structured POM and test source surface
supported_families.meson: Meson native test introspection or structured test declaration
supported_families.python: explicit supported pytest/tox/runner configuration; filenames alone are insufficient
